description.html: Arcadia EarthPro CalciumPro-Mg is a finely ground calcium powder with added magnesium. According to the manufacturer, it is 90% calcium carbonate and 10% magnesium carbonate, with B vitamins (B1, B2, B6, B12, biotin, folic acid) and vitamin K. It contains no vitamin D3, so it relies on good UVB lighting in the terrarium.

Arcadia notes that magnesium is part of the calcium, phosphorus and D3 cycle and matters for bones, muscles and the nervous system. CalciumPro-Mg is designed to replace a plain calcium powder in the regular diet.

Put feeder insects in a bag or tub with a little powder and shake gently until lightly coated. Under the official EarthPro feeding programme, CalciumPro-Mg is given at every 4th feed, while EarthPro-A is used at every feed. For herbivores, sprinkle the powder over salad and vegetables. Store sealed in a cool, dry place.
Suitable for lizards, geckos, chameleons, tortoises and amphibians. Find other supplements and UVB lighting in our equipment range.
